content: function  Can_SetControllerMode  [SWS_CP_CAN_00003]   Std_ReturnType Can_SetControllerMode(uint8 Controller, Can_ControllerStateType Transition); Transitions controller states between STOPPED, STARTED, and SLEEP. CAN Interface (CanIf) The CanIf abstracts CAN hardware details and provides uniform access to multiple CAN controllers and transceivers for higher-layer modules (PduR, CanTp, CanNm, CanSM).
